mapper.select: SELECT id, community_name as communityName, community_code as communityCd FROM communities WHERE state = 1 AND del_flag = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, sex, password, email, phone, address, role, state) VALUE (#{username},#{sex},#{password},#{email},#{phone},#{address},#{role},#{state})
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET username = #{username}, sex = #{sex}, password = #{password}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address} WHERE id = #{id}
